findings.current:
Still, there was no comparing them to the mad dogs of that insane cult of fanatics, a group that had stood shoulder to shoulder with the Murim world for more than a thousand years.

Of course, it seemed those mad dogs now served a different master.
findings.defect: The source singles out one exceptionally rabid dog among the cultists, then says that dog serves a new master. The draft makes both references plural.
findings.rationale: 유독 미쳐 있던 광견 and 그 미친개 are singular references to the man Taekyung is confronting.
findings.replacement:
Still, there was no comparing them to the one mad dog who stood out even among that insane cult of fanatics, a group that had stood shoulder to shoulder with the Murim world for more than a thousand years.

Of course, that mad dog seemed to serve a different master now.
findings.source:
하지만 장장 일천여 년에 걸쳐 천하 무림과 어깨를 나란히 했던, 미친 광신도 집단에서도 유독 미쳐 있던 광견과는 비교 자체가 불가능했다.

물론, 그 미친개는 이제 다른 주인을 섬기는 것 같지만.

findings.current: “So, after switching masters, do you get your meals on time?”
findings.defect: The draft drops the collar image that makes Taekyung's question an insult directed at a dog.
findings.rationale: 목줄 갈아 끼우니까 explicitly describes changing collars; the food question continues the dog metaphor.
findings.replacement: “So, with a new collar on, do they feed you on time?”
findings.source: 그래서, 목줄 갈아 끼우니까 밥은 제때 잘 나오고?

findings.defect: Taekyung repeats the collar insult, but the draft replaces it with a neutral account of changing masters.
findings.rationale: 목줄을 바꿔 낀 것이 repeats the specific image introduced in his earlier taunt.

findings.current: “‘Switched masters’ is a bit much… But think whatever you like.”
findings.defect: The Demon Lord objects specifically to being described as changing collars, not to the factual claim that he changed masters.
findings.rationale: His response names 목줄, preserving the exchange's pointed dog metaphor.
findings.replacement: “‘Changed collars’ is a bit much… But think whatever you like.”
findings.source: 목줄을 바꿨다는 표현은 좀 그렇긴 하지만…… 뭐, 편한 대로 생각하게.

findings.current: ordinary features—not particularly handsome, not particularly plain
findings.defect: The draft contrasts handsome with plain, although the source contrasts handsome with ugly.
findings.rationale: 못나지도 않은 means he is not ugly; 평범한 supplies the separate description of his features as ordinary.
findings.replacement: ordinary features—neither particularly handsome nor ugly
findings.source: 그리 준수하지도, 못나지도 않은 평범한 이목구비

findings.current: Earth split beneath our toes. Sand crumbled.
findings.defect: The earth is gouged by their feet, not split.
findings.rationale: 흙이 파인다 describes earth being dug or gouged as they launch forward.
findings.replacement: Our toes gouged the earth. Sand crumbled.
findings.source: 발끝을 따라 흙이 파인다. 모래가 부서진다.

summary: The draft changes a singular reference to the Blood-Sword Demon Lord into a plural one and loses the repeated collar insult. Two smaller physical descriptions also need correction.
